properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Low-Code / AI Workflow Runtime Sandbox-Escape — Server Process Spawns Shell + Public Egress
properties.description:
Detects the post-exploitation pivot common to this fortnight's cluster of GHSA-published RCEs in Node.js, Python and Rust application runtimes: an embedded code-execution feature that is *supposed* to be sandboxed (n8n HTTP Request / XML nodes — CVE-2026-44789, CVE-2026-44791; FlowiseAI NodeVM Custom JS — CVE-2026-46442; vm2 async-generator sandbox breakout — CVE-2026-45411; DeepSeek-TUI run_tests / task_create auto-approved exec — CVE-2026-45311, CVE-2026-45374; utcp-cli unsanitized arg substitution — CVE-2026-45369; Portainer Docker plugin auth bypass — CVE-2026-44848) causes the runtime parent (node, python, dotnet, cargo, portainer, deepseek-tui, n8n, flowise) to fork a real OS shell, LOLBin, or download tool, optionally followed by outbound egress to a public destination from the same parent. It spans exploit -> install (T1190 -> T1059 / T1105). It fires when the runtime spawns a child it has no business spawning AND the child cmdline carries an injection / staging marker (base64, /dev/tcp/, IEX, bash -i, child_process, getBuiltinModule, constructor.constructor, `etc/passwd`, backticked subshells) AND the parent runtime made an outbound public connection in the surrounding 5 minutes; it will NOT fire on normal developer scaffolding (npm/yarn/pip/poetry/cargo build|test|run) because those cmdline patterns are explicitly suppressed.

Rationale: Every one of these 12 GHSAs reaches RCE through a sandboxed code-execution surface inside a long-running app runtime — vm2 / NodeVM (Flowise, n8n), Python interpreter (utcp-cli), Rust cargo test under deepseek-tui, or the Portainer/Docker-engine plugin path. The single behavioural invariant the catalog doesn't already cover is: the runtime parent itself spawns an OS shell or LOLBin whose cmdline contains exploit-staging tokens AND that runtime egresses to a public destination within five minutes — a join that survives IOC rotation because it keys on the parent-process / child-binary / behaviour triple, not on any one CVE's payload.
properties.query:
let WindowMin = 5m;
let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where ParentProcessName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where TargetProcessName in~ (ShellOrLolbin)
    | where not(ParentProcessCommandLine matches regex BenignDevPatterns)
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex InjectionMarker
    | project ShellTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
              TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,
              TargetProcessSHA256;
let RuntimeEgress = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
    | where ActingProcessName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | where EventResult == "Success"
    | project EgressTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              ActingProcessName, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url;
RuntimeShells
| join kind=inner RuntimeEgress on DvcHostname
| where EgressTime between (ShellTime - WindowMin .. ShellTime + WindowMin)
| summarize EgressIPs = make_set(DstIpAddr, 25),
            EgressUrls = make_set(Url, 25),
            FirstEgress = min(EgressTime),
            LastEgress  = max(EgressTime)
            by ShellTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessSHA256
| order by ShellTime desc
